public.geography_columns.name: geography_columns
public.geography_columns.definition: SELECT current_database() AS f_table_catalog, n.nspname AS f_table_schema, c.relname AS f_table_name, a.attname AS f_geography_column, postgis_typmod_dims(a.atttypmod) AS coord_dimension, postgis_typmod_srid(a.atttypmod) AS srid, postgis_typmod_type(a.atttypmod) AS type FROM pg_class c, pg_attribute a, pg_type t, pg_namespace n WHERE t.typname = 'geography'::name AND a.attisdropped = false AND a.atttypid = t.oid AND a.attrelid = c.oid AND c.relnamespace = n.oid AND (c.relkind = ANY (ARRAY['r'::"char", 'v'::"char", 'm'::"char", 'f'::"char", 'p'::"char"])) AND NOT pg_is_other_temp_schema(c.relnamespace) AND has_table_privilege(c.oid, 'SELECT'::text)

public.geometry_columns.name: geometry_columns
public.geometry_columns.definition: SELECT current_database()::character varying(256) AS f_table_catalog, n.nspname AS f_table_schema, c.relname AS f_table_name, a.attname AS f_geometry_column, COALESCE(postgis_typmod_dims(a.atttypmod), sn.ndims, 2) AS coord_dimension, COALESCE(NULLIF(postgis_typmod_srid(a.atttypmod), 0), sr.srid, 0) AS srid, replace(replace(COALESCE(NULLIF(upper(postgis_typmod_type(a.atttypmod)), 'GEOMETRY'::text), st.type, 'GEOMETRY'::text), 'ZM'::text, ''::text), 'Z'::text, ''::text)::character varying(30) AS type FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid = c.oid AND NOT a.attisdropped JOIN pg_namespace n ON c.relnamespace = n.oid JOIN pg_type t ON a.atttypid = t.oid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.connamespace, s.conrelid, s.conkey, replace(split_part(s.consrc, ''''::text, 2), ')'::text, ''::text) AS type FROM ( SELECT pg_constraint.connamespace, pg_constraint.conrelid, pg_constraint.conkey, pg_get_constraintdef(pg_constraint.oid) AS consrc FROM pg_constraint) s WHERE s.consrc ~~* '%geometrytype(% = %'::text) st ON st.connamespace = n.oid AND st.conrelid = c.oid AND (a.attnum = ANY (st.conkey)) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.connamespace, s.conrelid, s.conkey, replace(split_part(s.consrc, ' = '::text, 2), ')'::text, ''::text)::integer AS ndims FROM ( SELECT pg_constraint.connamespace, pg_constraint.conrelid, pg_constraint.conkey, pg_get_constraintdef(pg_constraint.oid) AS consrc FROM pg_constraint) s WHERE s.consrc ~~* '%ndims(% = %'::text) sn ON sn.connamespace = n.oid AND sn.conrelid = c.oid AND (a.attnum = ANY (sn.conkey)) LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.connamespace, s.conrelid, s.conkey, replace(replace(split_part(s.consrc, ' = '::text, 2), ')'::text, ''::text), '('::text, ''::text)::integer AS srid FROM ( SELECT pg_constraint.connamespace, pg_constraint.conrelid, pg_constraint.conkey, pg_get_constraintdef(pg_constraint.oid) AS consrc FROM pg_constraint) s WHERE s.consrc ~~* '%srid(% = %'::text) sr ON sr.connamespace = n.oid AND sr.conrelid = c.oid AND (a.attnum = ANY (sr.conkey)) WHERE (c.relkind = ANY (ARRAY['r'::"char", 'v'::"char", 'm'::"char", 'f'::"char", 'p'::"char"])) AND NOT c.relname = 'raster_columns'::name AND t.typname = 'geometry'::name AND NOT pg_is_other_temp_schema(c.relnamespace) AND has_table_privilege(c.oid, 'SELECT'::text)

public.user_properties_full.name: user_properties_full
public.user_properties_full.definition: SELECT up.zpid AS userzpid, p.zpid, p.search_market, p.address, p.address_street, p.address_city, p.address_state, p.address_zip, p.full_address, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.county, p.home_status, p.home_type, p.listing_status, p.days_on_zillow, p.price, p.list_price, p.zestimate, p.rent_estimate, p.rent_zestimate, p.tax_assessed, p.tax_assessed_value, p.size_sq_ft, p.living_area_sq_ft, p.price_per_sq_ft, p.num_beds, p.num_baths, p.year_built, p.down_payment, p.closing_costs, p.total_cash_needed, p.monthly_mortgage, p.monthly_taxes, p.monthly_expenses, p.monthly_cash_flow, p.annual_cash_flow, p.cap_rate_percent, p.cash_on_cash_roi, p.dscr, p.five_year_gain, p.equity_at_purchase, p.investment_score_percent, p.is_cash_flow_negative, p.is_rent_estimate_missing, p.is_below_zestimate, p.is_foreclosure, p.is_new_construction, p.url, p.img_main, p.fetch_count, p.last_fetched_at, p.created_at, p.updated_at, pd.listing_agent_name, pd.listing_agent_phone, pd.listing_agent_email, pd.brokerage_name, pd.description, ps.name AS pipeline_stage_name, ps.color AS pipeline_stage_color FROM user_properties up JOIN properties p ON up.zpid = p.zpid LEFT JOIN property_details pd ON p.zpid = pd.zpid LEFT JOIN pipeline_stages ps ON up.pipeline_stage_id = ps.id

public.properties_with_motivation.name: properties_with_motivation
public.properties_with_motivation.definition: SELECT p.zpid, p.search_market, p.address, p.address_street, p.address_city, p.address_state, p.address_zip, p.full_address, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.county, p.home_status, p.home_type, p.listing_status, p.days_on_zillow, p.price, p.list_price, p.zestimate, p.rent_estimate, p.rent_zestimate, p.tax_assessed, p.tax_assessed_value, p.size_sq_ft, p.living_area_sq_ft, p.price_per_sq_ft, p.num_beds, p.num_baths, p.year_built, p.down_payment, p.closing_costs, p.total_cash_needed, p.monthly_mortgage, p.monthly_taxes, p.monthly_expenses, p.monthly_cash_flow, p.annual_cash_flow, p.cap_rate_percent, p.cash_on_cash_roi, p.dscr, p.five_year_gain, p.equity_at_purchase, p.investment_score_percent, p.is_cash_flow_negative, p.is_rent_estimate_missing, p.is_below_zestimate, p.is_foreclosure, p.is_new_construction, p.url, p.img_main, p.fetch_count, p.last_fetched_at, p.created_at, p.updated_at, msa.motivation_score, msa.motivation_level, msa.is_fsbo, msa.analyzed_at AS motivation_analyzed_at FROM properties p LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT motivated_seller_analysis.id, motivated_seller_analysis.zpid, motivated_seller_analysis.motivation_score, motivated_seller_analysis.motivation_level, motivated_seller_analysis.keywords_found, motivated_seller_analysis.urgent_keywords, motivated_seller_analysis.moderate_keywords, motivated_seller_analysis.mild_keywords, motivated_seller_analysis.negative_keywords, motivated_seller_analysis.is_fsbo, motivated_seller_analysis.emails_in_description, motivated_seller_analysis.phones_in_description, motivated_seller_analysis.analyzed_at, motivated_seller_analysis.created_at FROM motivated_seller_analysis WHERE motivated_seller_analysis.zpid = p.zpid ORDER BY motivated_seller_analysis.analyzed_at DESC LIMIT 1) msa ON true
